options.name: disable_windows_update
options.description: If V(true), prevents DISM from contacting Windows Update for the source files.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Sets the maximum output level for DISM logging. V(0) logs errors only V(1) logs errors and warnings V(2) logs errors, warnings, and information V(3) logs all of the previous plus debug output. This log is managed by DISM itself, the values allowed may change with different versions of Windows.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Specifies the full path and file name to log to. If not specified the logging uses the default DISM log file location which is V(%WINDIR%\\Logs\\Dism\\dism.log).

options.name: name
options.description: A list of capability names to filter by. Supports wildcard patterns like V(?) for single character matching and V(*) for multiple character matching. If not specified, all capabilities will be returned.

options.name: source
options.description: Finds capabilities that are available in the specified source locations.
